root_cause: Pearson changed the papers-note wording between layout generations: the 2019/2020-era linear docs print 'Papers 1C & 2C' / 'Papers 1B, 1C & 1P' and, for single-paper subjects (English Language B, Bangla, Global Citizenship, Islamic Studies, Sinhala, Tamil), singular 'Paper 01'; the 2022+ era prints 'Paper(s) 1C 2C' / 'Paper(s) 1B 1C 1P'. parse_pearson.py gated on the Paper(s) prefix only, so all three oldest docs dropped every label — the hub served papersNote null for 8 duplicate-session pairs on 4CH1 (June 2019 / January 2020 carried NO label at all).
the_fix: parse_pearson.py accepts all three wordings and normalizes to the canonical 2022+ shape (ampersand + commas stripped, singular prefix stripped): 'Papers 1C & 2C' -> '1C 2C', 'Papers 1B, 1C & 1P' -> '1B 1C 1P' (verified equal to the January 2022 4SD0 canonical), 'Paper 01' -> '01' (verified equal to the 2022+ 4EB1 canonical).

regression_assert.parsed_layer: 129 fills — January 2019: 20, June 2019: 74, January 2020: 35; every fill None -> document-sourced label; ZERO value rewrites; ZERO row reorders; every other field of every subject byte-identical (incl. the note's own 111 estimate corrected: it counted only multi-row variant groups — 20 single-row subjects had lost labels the same way)
regression_assert.bundle_layer: 133 series fills across 21 served slugs (chemistry-19 4, biology-19 4, physics-19 4, english-language-a-16 x3 slugs 18 each, english-literature-16 17, maths-a-18-foundation/higher 6 each, maths-b-16 6, science-double-award-17 x3 slugs 4 each, accounting-17 x2 slugs 2 each, economics-17 4, business-19 2, geography-19 2, history-17 2, ict-17 2, further-maths-19 4); all 227 (course, session) joins verified label-list-equal against the parsed layer; bundle diff contains ONLY generated + the fills
regression_assert.honest_remainders: the two 4ES1 rows whose document subline reads 'Speaking Endorsement' (June 2019, January 2020 — not a paper combination; the 2022+ era numbers that paper 03) and the January 2020 singles whose document prints no note line at all (4AC1/4CM1/4HB1) stay papersNote null — the em-dash + footnote law stays alive for exactly the rows the source itself leaves unlabelled
